verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a broad public REST API. It covers sending (single, batch, template, and bulk endpoints), templates, bounces, message search, stats, webhooks, servers, message streams, domains/DKIM, and sender signatures. It also documents token-header auth, a `POSTMARK_API_TEST` test token, official SDKs in many languages, and an AI-oriented llms.txt (probe returned 200). A community user confirms driving it with plain curl/POST requests. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404) and a markdown docs endpoint (developer.md returned 404).
